question: For each migration status, show the status and compute the average and variance of the migrated instance memory size in MB, considering only non-deleted migrations for instances that have an INSTANCE_EXTRA record, and only for active migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;
column_mapping: {"migration status": ["MIGRATIONS.STATUS"], "migrated instance memory size in MB": ["INSTANCES.MEMORY_MB"], "non-deleted migrations": ["MIGRATIONS.DELETED"], "instances that have an INSTANCE_EXTRA record": ["INSTANCE_EXTRA.INSTANCE_UUID"]}
domain_knowledge: ["\"Active migrations\" is predicated by \"migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')\""]

expected.sql: SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;
expected.column_mapping: {"migration status": ["MIGRATIONS.STATUS"], "migrated instance memory size in MB": ["INSTANCES.MEMORY_MB"], "non-deleted migrations": ["MIGRATIONS.DELETED"], "instances that have an INSTANCE_EXTRA record": ["INSTANCE_EXTRA.INSTANCE_UUID"]}
